title: Review how childcare services are assessed against the national quality standard
action: Commission an independent review of the National Quality Framework focused on making assessments of services more accurate, consistent and efficient, and repeat such reviews regularly.
why: Infrequent, inconsistent assessments add compliance cost without giving families or regulators reliable information about quality, which weakens competition on quality.

evidence.source: A path to universal early childhood education and care (volume 1)
evidence.quote: The Australian, state and territory governments should, through the Education Ministers Meeting, commission an independent review of the National Quality Framework (NQF), with a specific focus on the way in which services are assessed against the National Quality Standard, and if assessments could be made more accurate, consistent and efficient.
